# R2.15 — Verification-plane legs — postconditions, diff_sanity, validator suite

Ticket `docs/tickets/121_R2.15__verification-plane-legs.md`
(seq 121). Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.14` (PR #121);
ADR-0347. Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — the only
out-of-process wire is `plugin_abi/1` over `hh-varhost` fixtures; no
live model, judge or validator service was contacted, and none is
claimed.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.21-1 · DF-S1.21-2 · DF-S1.21-3 · BL-17 ·
ADR-0316 · R-2.7.1 · R-2.7.2a · R-2.7.2b · R-2.7.3.

## What landed

**Postcondition + `diff_sanity` consumption (DF-S1.21-1 → DONE;
ADR-0347 D1).** `fold_effect_states` lifts
`action.effect.observed.postcondition_results[]` onto `EffectStateRow`
(absent ⇒ `[]` — additive, never fabricated), and `bind_claim` admits
a declared-postcondition verdict through the claim's cited effect
(`subject = effect{…}` or an `effect:`-prefixed evidence ref) beside
the directly-cited and in-contract-criterion paths. A non-affirmative
postcondition/`diff_sanity` verdict on cited evidence now contradicts
an `achieved` claim as `unverified_verification` (`claims.rs`
`(Achieved, Verdict{!affirmative})`) — a declared validator can no
longer fail silently beside a success claim.

**Belief-probe emitters (ADR-0316; ADR-0347 D2).**
`hh-verification::belief_probe` decodes `ProfileRule{kind =
belief_probe}` at `open`/`resume` (a debtless rule refuses typed —
`DriverError::MalformedProfileRule`, never silently dropped), elicits
the declared `beliefs` items off each step's *recorded*
`calls[].args_raw`, and appends one `verification.belief.probe` row
per elicitation — `provisional: true` constitutive, `charged_to =
subject`. Subject spellings resolve durable rows only: `effect:<id>`,
`call:<tool_call_id>` (two hops through `intent.tool_call_id` — the
model names the call it minted, never the kernel's `ef-N`), and
`verdict:<id>`; the `observed_ref` is the `row:<event_id>` handle.
Unresolved subjects keep `observed_ref: null`/`divergent: false` —
never a fabricated comparison — and `judged` rules decode but never
fire in the deterministic emitter (strata stay separate).

**OOP validator conformance suite (DF-S1.21-2; ADR-0347 D5).**
`crates/hh-varhost/tests/validator_conformance.rs` (9 cells) drives
`declare`/`bind`/`collect`/`check` over `plugin_abi/1` through
`hh-plugin-fixture`'s new `validator` mode — which runs the *real*
`hh-verification` semantics (`validators::declare`/`bind`,
`build_bundle`, the `Verdict` contract; CC1/CC7, not a re-spelling).
`validators::declaration_json` is the one canonical `declare` doc.
Contract failures answer typed in-band docs; `--validator-*` flags
doctor the canned declaration so the negative arms hit
`IncompleteDeclaration`/`ValidatorHasEffects`/`PayloadHashMismatch`
for real.

**Computed metrics on live runs (DF-S1.21-2; ADR-0347 D4).**
`Driver::finish` folds the durable prefix through
`evalfold::compute` and appends one `measurement.metric.emitted` per
registered ADR-0114 D1 metric — typed `MetricValue` with
`n/a{reason}` first-class (`observability`/`no_evidence` map onto the
closed `NaReason` sum; never a silent zero), `detector =
deterministic`, `oracle_ref = oracle/evalfold` — before
`lifecycle.run.finished` so the terminal row stays terminal and the
values replay byte-identically (INV-9).

**The recorded-judge binding (DF-S1.21-3 progress; ADR-0347 D3).**
`RecordedJudge` (`hh-control::loops`) is the offline
`Validator{kind = judge}` port: it folds durable `detector = judged`
`verification.{validator,critic}.verdict` rows into replayed
confidence answers for `detect_with_judge` via `DriverConfig.judge`.
A bound `validator_ref` with no recorded judged verdict abstains —
identical to `judge: None`, never a fabricated judgment; the judged
`stop` clamp stands. The live `link`-time
`CriticDeclaration{kind = judge}` binding stays OPEN under
`offline-only` — environment-gated.
